name: SuperCraftOS verification
postCreateCommand: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt; echo "pip-exit=$?" > install-exit.log; python3 -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py" > py-results.log 2>&1; echo "python-exit=$?" >> py-results.log; python3 scripts/audit_repository.py > audit-results.log 2>&1; echo "audit-exit=$?" >> audit-results.log; git config user.email "ci@supercraftos.local"; git config user.name "ci-bot"; git checkout -B ci-results; git add -f install-exit.log py-results.log audit-results.log; git commit -m "Automated verification results"; git push origin HEAD:ci-results
